answer: To resist Sybil attacks, agents sign ledger assertions like a digital quill, backing claims with bonded stake. A game-theoretic multi-agent auditing network samples topological cut verifications across the interaction graph to detect clustered replicas. Dishonest coordinates face immediate stake slashing, draining malicious capital across an ocean of collateralized validator pools. This forces attacker cost to scale superlinearly beyond the horizon of any viable exploit.
